gates.requirement: Godot starts with zero parser/runtime errors and existing V1.5 runtime gate remains PASS.
Left click ground moves; left click target selects without unintended movement interruption; left click loot approaches/picks.
Right click is click-only contextual action; hostile chase/attack respects cooldown.
Pickup impossible above 0.5m, through blocker, or before drop settles.
Tree/rock/ore/flora/agriculture/hunt/fish/enemy physical output appears as Ground Loot before inventory.
Auto Pickup ON/OFF works, persists, and never interrupts attack/movement.
Terrain has subtle relief; movement stable; no micro-collision snagging/camera jitter; no body-balance mechanic.
Slope+surface+load affect authoritative stamina; yellow radial player-adjacent stamina circle depletes/refills and disappears completely at 100% when inactive.
Large logical areas stream by cells; only active+preload detailed; distant area remains Living SYSTEMIC.
Realtime NPC dialogue uses rounded white bubble, gray normal text, light-orange important text, no Next button, no world pause.
NPC names appear on hover only; multiple NPC conversations alternate without bubble spam; choices appear near NPC.
Important dialogue simultaneously appears in world bubble and subtle bottom accessibility line.
HUD remains minimal/contextual; enemy bars stable/straight; alpha HP+shield; inventory toggled with I; HUD/inventory/dialogue share white rounded legible UI language.
Camera stays stable over micro-relief, zoom clamps, occluders fade, no forced combat zoom/free orbit; mouse wheel zoom works only while zoom modifier is held.
Game-feel feedback never changes gameplay result; local hit freeze only; reduced-motion disables camera impulse/local freeze.
Vendor requires explicit quote/execute; approaching/clicking shop never auto-purchases.
Save/reload preserves player, world, Ground Loot, Auto Pickup, quest/economy, water exposure, bag ownership/state and death recovery state.

Stage16 death policy preserves XP plus equipped weapons/armor/clothes, drops equipped Bag as one container when present, and protects quest/critical unique items from permanent loss; Stage15 historical baseline remains unmodified.
Full vertical slice spawn→explore→water/terrain traversal→dialogue→quest→combat→loot→gather→vendor→save→death/bag drop→respawn completes without debugger errors.
No canonical Master mutation; Stage16A 209/209 + stress20/20 and touched regressions remain PASS after Godot implementation.
Player quick loadout exposes exactly 2 weapon slots; inventory may contain more weapons; only one slot is active/equipped in MAIN_HAND at a time and inactive weapon modifiers do not stack.
Keys 1/2 activate their weapon slots; unmodified mouse wheel toggles weapons; modifier+wheel zooms; menu/UI wheel scroll does not swap weapon or zoom.

Dialogue, inventory, vendors, crafting, tooltips, choices and HUD share the unified white/off-white rounded clean-console UI family with rounded legible gray text and soft-orange important text; no copied Nintendo/Zelda assets.

Shallow rivers are traversable by player/NPC/animal and ordinary vehicles when depth permits; under-bridge shallow water remains traversable; stronger current increases living-actor stamina cost while vehicles use traction/speed penalty rather than stamina.

Deep water switches player/NPC/animal to swimming with higher stamina drain; zero-stamina water exhaustion uses the configured grace window and can result in defeat/death; ordinary non-water-capable vehicles are blocked from deep water.

Without a Bag, carried inventory uses the reduced base-slot policy; equipped Bag is a real inventory container; the two quick-slot weapons and equipped armor/clothes remain with the owner on death; protected quest/critical unique items cannot be permanently lost.

Individual Ground Loot in water becomes non-recoverable/sinks after 15 minutes of authoritative exposure; dropped Bag floats for 30 minutes in water, while a Bag dropped on land has no expiry until recovered; timers survive save/reload.
Player may recover an NPC Bag while original property ownership remains recorded and can drive contextual reaction; foreign NPCs do not automatically take another NPC bag.
